name: Brampton Trinity Common / North York
description: The Trinity Common–North York family joined Brampton terminals to the Yonge Street corridor using Highway 407. Its Richmond Hill-area stop was Langstaff / Yonge, not Richmond Hill Centre.

timeline.event: The table connects Hurontario / Bovaird and Trinity Common through Bramalea to Langstaff / Yonge, Finch and Sheppard.
Service moved from Dixie Road to Highway 410, removing the local Dixie stops.
The table includes Williams Parkway/Highway 410 and York Mills, plus a Bramalea Transit Terminal branch.
